items.source: The RedisConnection interface serves as a common abstraction across various Redis client libraries (or drivers).
items.translation: RedisConnection 接口作为各种 Redis 客户端库（或驱动程序）之间的通用抽象。

items.source: Redis connections, unlike perhaps their underlying native connection are not Thread-safe and should not be shared across multiple threads, concurrently or simultaneously.
items.translation: 与底层的原生连接不同，Redis 连接并非线程安全的，因此不应在多个线程（无论是并发还是同时）之间共享。

items.source: Redis command methods are exempted from the default non-nullable return value assumption as nullness depends not only on the command but also on the connection state. Methods invoked during a transaction or while pipelining are required to return null at the time invoking a command as the response is not available until the transaction is executed or the pipeline is closed. To avoid excessive null checks in calling code and to not express a faulty assumption of non-nullness, all command interfaces are annotated with @NullUnmarked.
items.translation: Redis 命令方法免除了默认的非空返回值假设，因为是否为 null 不仅取决于命令本身，还取决于连接状态。在事务期间或管道模式下调用的方法必须在调用命令时返回 null，因为响应只有在事务执行完成或管道关闭后才可用。为了避免调用代码中出现过多的 null 检查，并避免表达错误的非空假设，所有命令接口均标注了 @NullUnmarked。

items.source:
Indicates whether the connection is in "queue"(or "MULTI") mode or not. When queueing, all commands are postponed
until EXEC or DISCARD commands are issued. Since in queueing no results are returned, the connection will return
NULL on all operations that interact with the data.
items.translation: 指示连接是否处于"队列"(或"MULTI")模式。当启用队列时，所有命令将推迟执行，直到发出 EXEC 或 DISCARD 命令为止。由于在队列模式下不会返回任何结果，因此与数据交互的所有操作都将返回 NULL。

items.source:

items.source: Activates the pipeline mode for this connection. When pipelined, all commands return null (the reply is read at the end through closePipeline(). Calling this method when the connection is already pipelined has no effect. Pipelining is used for issuing commands without requesting the response right away but rather at the end of the batch. While somewhat similar to MULTI, pipelining does not guarantee atomicity - it only tries to improve performance when issuing a lot of commands (such as in batching scenarios).
items.translation: 启用此连接的管道模式。当处于管道模式时，所有命令均返回 null（回复将在最后通过closePipeline()读取）。如果连接已经处于管道模式，调用此方法将不会产生任何效果。管道模式用于在不立即请求响应而是等到批次结束时才请求响应的情况下发出命令。虽然与 MULTI 有些相似，但管道模式并不保证原子性——它仅在发出大量命令（例如在批量操作场景中）时尝试提高性能。

items.source:
Consider doing some performance testing before using this feature since in many cases the performance benefits are
minimal yet the impact on usage are not.
items.translation: 在使用此功能之前，建议先进行性能测试，因为在许多情况下，其带来的性能提升微乎其微，但对使用体验的影响却不容忽视。
